title: Sum of Beauty in the Array
summary: Given an array of integers, calculate the beauty of each element at index i (1 i, the beauty is 2; if nums[i - 1] < nums[i] < nums[i + 1] but the first condition does not hold, the beauty is 1; otherwise, the beauty is 0.
statement: Given an array of integers, calculate the beauty of each element at index i (1 i, the beauty is 2; if nums[i - 1] < nums[i] < nums[i + 1] but the first condition does not hold, the beauty is 1; otherwise, the beauty is 0. Sum the beauties of all elements that meet these criteria.
constraints: An interior value earns two when it is greater than every earlier value and smaller than every later value.
Otherwise it earns one only when greater than its immediate predecessor and smaller than its immediate successor.
reference_solution:
def sum_of_array_beauties(nums):
    right=[0]*len(nums);smallest=float('inf')
    for i in range(len(nums)-1,-1,-1):smallest=min(smallest,nums[i]);right[i]=smallest
    largest=nums[0];answer=0
    for i in range(1,len(nums)-1):
        if largest<nums[i]<right[i+1]:answer+=2
        elif nums[i-1]<nums[i]<nums[i+1]:answer+=1
        largest=max(largest,nums[i])
    return answer
